positions.as_written: Identify the lesion at its classic site and assess its size in two planes.
Assess the overlying cartilage for continuity, since an intact surface over a lesion is the favourable pattern.
Assess the physes and record the skeletal maturity, because it changes the interpretation.
The classic site is where it is because of the loading pattern there, so a lesion at an atypical site should prompt a different differential.
